name: Bold pop
mechanism: Every shape wears the same thick navy outline and sits on a solid navy extrusion stepped down-right, so the whole cluster reads as chunky pop-art blocks stacked toward the viewer.

palette.name: Navy
palette.role: every outline, extrusions, iso shadow faces, hatching, dots, eyes, mouths, curly hair

palette.name: White
palette.role: window bodies, pinwheel facets, sneakers, teeth, tee stripes

palette.role: hero blocks, buttons, cones, hair, tongue, progress stripes

line: Navy #1f1c4d outline 3.0 author units (2.34 px after the 0.78 card scale) on every shape, inner parts 2.2-2.6, marks 1.8, folds and finger contours 1.3-1.6, hatch 1.25 on a 5 grid; round caps and joins; extrusions 3-8 units stepped down-right.
rules: One navy outline, 3.0 author units, on every shape
Every extrusion is solid navy and steps down-right
Flat saturated fills textured with navy hatch, dots, grids, stripes
Hatch the right or far side; light comes from the top-left
A slim 3/4 character beside a dense overlapping prop cluster
Scatter #, //, + and rings in the margins, never gradients
